# Lume Design System

> A design system in native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with no dependencies: tokens, typography, 130 custom icons, components, charts, and screen patterns, in light and dark themes. Version 0.39.0.

Start with [README](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/README.md): installation, general rules, and what never to invent. Every page of the site has a Markdown file below, generated from it.

## Getting started

- [README](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/README.md): rules for AIs, installation, and visual direction
- [AGENTS.md](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/AGENTS.md): short rules to copy into a project root
- [Icons](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/icons.md): the exact list of names `<ds-icon>` accepts
- [Claude skill](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/lume-design-system.zip): the same guidance as a skill

## Lume

- [Getting started](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/primeiros-passos.md): How to install, import the styles, and use the tokens in your project.

## Foundations

- [Color](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/cores.md): OKLCH palettes, semantic tokens, and dark and light themes.
- [Typography](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/tipografia.md): Geist Serif for headings, Geist Sans for reading, and 19 text styles.
- [Icons](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/icones.md): A custom library on a 24 px grid with a 1.5 stroke.
- [Spacing](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/espacamento.md): A 4 px scale for rhythm and alignment.
- [Radius](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/raios.md): Generous corners — from subtle to pill.
- [Elevation](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/elevacao.md): Surface layers and shadows that create hierarchy.
- [Motion](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/movimento.md): Durations and curves for purposeful transitions.
- [Layout](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/fundamentos/layout.md): Breakpoints, grid, and app shell dimensions.

## Components

- [Button](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/botao.md): Triggers an action. Primary, secondary, ghost, subtle, and danger.
- [Inline action](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/acao-inline.md): The quietest action: inside the content, with + or →.
- [Chip](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/chip.md): A pill to filter, choose, and show selections.
- [Menu](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/menu.md): A list that opens from a trigger, to pick a value or run actions.
- [Toolbar](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/barra-de-ferramentas.md): Grouped icon buttons, with a single Tab stop and arrow keys between them.
- [Text field](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/campo-de-texto.md): Label, hint, error, and counter — single line or multiline.
- [Select](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/selecao.md): Single, searchable, or multiple — a list that looks like a menu, with a real select underneath.
- [Checkbox and radio](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/checkbox-radio.md): Many choices or just one, with groups and an indeterminate state.
- [Switch](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/switch.md): Turns something on or off, right away.
- [Date picker](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/seletor-de-data.md): A day or a range, typed or picked from the calendar.
- [Time picker](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/seletor-de-horario.md): Hours and minutes in the locale’s format, typed or from the list.
- [Number field](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/campo-numerico.md): A number with − and +, limits, a step, and the locale’s format.
- [Slider](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/slider.md): A value or a range, when position matters more than the exact number.
- [Tag field](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/campo-de-tags.md): Several free values inside one field.
- [Color picker](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/seletor-de-cor.md): A free color or one from the palette, with hex and keyboard.
- [Rating](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/avaliacao.md): Stars to give a score or show the average, with half stars.
- [File upload](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/upload.md): Drag or browse, with progress and errors per file.
- [Verification code](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/codigo-de-verificacao.md): One digit per box, for two-step sign-in.
- [Rich text editor](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/editor-de-texto-rico.md): A field that formats: headings, lists, quotes, and links, with Lume’s toolbar.
- [Tabs](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/abas.md): Switch between views of the same subject. Underlined or segmented.
- [Segmented control](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/controle-segmentado.md): A few options side by side, one selected.
- [Breadcrumb](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/breadcrumb.md): The path to the current page.
- [Link](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/link.md): Inline and standalone links, with an external-link cue.
- [Pagination](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/paginacao.md): Pages of a list or table, with a total and items per page.
- [Stepper](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/stepper.md): The steps of a flow and where the person is.
- [Accordion](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/acordeao.md): Sections that open and close in place.
- [Tree](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/arvore.md): Folders and nested levels, with keyboard support.
- [Scrollbar](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/barra-de-rolagem.md): A single bar that appears while people scroll.
- [Back to top](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/voltar-ao-topo.md): Takes you back to the start on long pages.
- [Modal](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/modal.md): Interrupts for a decision or short task, with destructive confirmation.
- [Drawer](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/gaveta-lateral.md): Details or a task without leaving the page.
- [Popover](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/popover.md): Free content that opens on click, attached to its trigger.
- [Context menu](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/menu-de-contexto.md): Item actions, with a right-click or the keyboard.
- [Tooltip](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/tooltip.md): A short hint on hover and focus — names icons and teaches shortcuts.
- [Alert](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/alerta.md): A message on the page itself, in the status tones.
- [Announcement banner](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/banner-de-anuncio.md): A strip at the top of the app with a message for everyone, which people can close.
- [Toast](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/toast.md): Confirms what happened without interrupting; tones, undo, and six positions.
- [Notification center](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/central-de-notificacoes.md): The bell with the list of what happened, read and unread.
- [Badge](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/badge.md): A short status or count label — never decoration.
- [Progress bar](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/barra-de-progresso.md): How much of a task is done.
- [Circular progress](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/progresso-circular.md): Progress in a ring, for when a bar doesn’t fit.
- [Spinner](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/spinner.md): A short wait, inside buttons too.
- [Skeleton](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/skeleton.md): The shape of the content before it arrives.
- [Card](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/card.md): The basic surface for grouping content.
- [Carousel](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/carrossel.md): Highlights that go by one at a time, with arrows, dots, and swipe.
- [Image viewer](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/visualizador-de-imagem.md): The large image over the page, with zoom, panning, and the gallery.
- [Sortable list](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/lista-arrastavel.md): Change the order by dragging, with the mouse, touch, or keyboard.
- [Kanban](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/kanban.md): Columns of cards that move from one to another.
- [Panel](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/painel.md): The surface of a task: label, title, controls, and sections.
- [Resizable panels](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/paineis-redimensionaveis.md): Areas people adjust by dragging the divider, with keyboard and saved size.
- [Divider](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/divisor.md): A line between blocks, horizontal and vertical, with an optional label.
- [Avatar](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/avatar.md): A person or account: photo, initials in a stable tone, status, and group.
- [Table](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/tabela.md): Data in rows and columns, with sorting and selection.
- [Calendar](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/calendario.md): Month, week, and day, with events and keyboard.
- [Timeline](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/linha-do-tempo.md): Events in order, like an activity history.
- [Description list](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/lista-de-definicoes.md): Label and value pairs, as on a details sheet.
- [Code block](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/bloco-de-codigo.md): Code with a copy button.
- [Keyboard key](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/componentes/tecla.md): Keyboard shortcuts within text.

## Charts

- [Overview](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/visao-geral.md): Which chart to use, colorblind-safe colors, anatomy, interaction, and accessibility.
- [Bars](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/barras.md): Columns and horizontal bars: grouped, stacked, 100%, diverging, and funnel.
- [Lines and areas](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/linhas.md): Trends over time, with a crosshair, end-of-line labels, goals, and stacked areas.
- [Donut](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/rosca.md): Part of a whole at a glance, with up to 6 slices and the total in the middle.
- [Heatmap](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/heatmap.md): Intensity on a grid or a calendar, on a sequential or diverging scale.
- [Scatter](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/dispersao.md): The relationship between two measures, with bubbles, reference lines, and selective labels.
- [Indicators](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/graficos/indicadores.md): When the chart is a number: stat, hero number, sparkline, and meter.

## Patterns

- [App shell](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/padroes/app-shell.md): Floating sidebar, main panel, top bar, and ⌘K search.
- [Chat and composer](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/padroes/conversa.md): Bubbles, responses, attachments, and the message box.
- [Forms](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/padroes/formularios.md): Fields, validation, and error messages that help people move on.
- [Sign-in and sign-up](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/padroes/login.md): Sign in, create an account, and reset the password — short and trap-free.
- [Empty states](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/padroes/estados-vazios.md): First use, no results, and errors — always with a next step.
- [Search and commands](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/padroes/busca.md): ⌘K palette, filters, and keyboard shortcuts.

## Resources

- [Accessibility](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/recursos/acessibilidade.md): Guidelines for products everyone can use.
- [Tokens for Figma](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/recursos/tokens.md): Token export for Figma and other tools.
- [API](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/recursos/api.md): Everything public in JavaScript, with the naming convention.
- [Use with React](https://lumeui.dev/ia/en/recursos/react.md): .tsx components to copy into a project, on top of Lume’s CSS and JavaScript.
